questions.stem: A 45-year-old patient is being investigated for suspected Cushing Syndrome. A standard 1-mg overnight dexamethasone suppression test (LDDST) is performed, where 1 mg of dexamethasone is administered orally at 11:00 PM, and serum cortisol is measured at 8:00 AM the following morning. Which of the following results would be most indicative of Cushing Syndrome?

options.label: C
options.text: Morning serum cortisol level of 1.2 mcg/dL, with simultaneous elevated ACTH

options.label: D
options.text: Serum cortisol level of 1.0 mcg/dL, following 24-hour urine free cortisol within normal limits
